module: Tracks the availability state of the interface frameworks ('vue' and 'angular') and chooses the initial screen. When both have announced uiReady, it emits the onAllUiReady hook then navigates to the startup screen (online consent, button layout, game, onboarding or menu) via ui_router. It also handles route resynchronization after an F5 reload of the UI.
notes: The unload mode is set to 'manual' on load: the extension does not unload automatically.
Unknown uiType (other than 'vue' or 'angular'): a warning is logged and the call is ignored.
After initialization, a new uiReady (F5 reload) emits 'ui_router_routeRefresh' for the announced framework and for those already ready.

initialized.desc: Becomes true when all frameworks are ready (set by _checkAllUiReady).

initialize.desc: Entry point. In headless mode, directly emits the onUiReady hook; otherwise loads the ui_router extension.

headlessMode.desc: true if the game runs without an interface.

uiReady.desc: Called by the UI when a framework is loaded. Emits onUiReady(uiType), marks the framework ready, then either resynchronizes the route (already initialized) or checks whether all are ready.

isUiReady.desc: Returns whether a given framework, or all if there is no argument, is ready.

uiType.desc: Framework to test, or nil for all.

checkAndSyncRoute.desc: After an F5 reload, sends the current route back to the UI via guihooks 'ui_router_routeRefresh' ({request, resolved, refreshedBy}) for each concerned framework.

uiType.desc: Framework that just announced itself again.

returns.desc: false if not yet initialized, otherwise true.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: disables automatic unloading of the extension.

navigateToInitialScreen.desc: Chooses the starting screen. Without a valid license: 'legal.onlineFeatures' if online consent is missing, then 'buttonLayout' if the layout window (showedInputLayoutPopupV37) has not been seen. Otherwise 'play' if entering the game (freeroam or loading state), 'onboarding' if not shown, otherwise 'menu'.

_checkAllUiReady.desc: If all frameworks are ready, sets initialized to true, emits onAllUiReady and starts navigateToInitialScreen.
